script: New hire asks about manager's flirting, gets fired for daring question!. The new hire walked in, eyes wide, asking if the manager was flirting with everyone. I didn't even need to explain it—he's always been a little too smooth for a kitchen guy. He swears on the back door, "Don't come into the kitchen anymore." I am already losing time, right? So I told him, "Get the bread, I am on the table." I am stuck in the server alley, staring at the line of orders that won't move. I hear a hiss from the kitchen, a silent warning that my food's still on the stove. I walk back in, heart racing, and shout, "Hey, is my order ready?" The manager, eyes narrowed, snaps, "You can come in, and you're really pissing me off." My whole petty heart just… exploded. (I know, right?)
